tagline: International Association for Inland Waterborne Transport and Logistics
hero_kpi_rationale: This indicator reflects the engagement and participation of stakeholders in the European inland navigation sector in IVR's key activities and initiatives, demonstrating its role as a leader and international coordination platform.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the IVR Annual Congress from different countries and business sectors.
kpis.description: The IVR Annual Congress, held May 15-17, 2024 in Frankfurt, brought together 225 participants from 11 different countries.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the appeal and relevance of the IVR platform for sector stakeholders.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Attendance
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the IVR's inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium.
kpis.description: The inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium, held November 4, 2024 in Antwerp, brought together approximately 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the success of specialized initiatives and industry professionals' engagement in risk prevention.

kpis.name: Countries Represented at Congress
kpis.explanation: Number of countries from which participants at the IVR Annual Congress originate.
kpis.description: The 2024 Annual Congress brought together participants from 11 different countries, highlighting the international nature of the organization.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the organization's geographic reach and international influence.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Presentations
kpis.explanation: Number of technical and financial presentations at the Loss Prevention Colloquium.
kpis.description: Eight presentations distributed across three sessions addressed technical and financial topics relevant to loss prevention in European inland navigation.
kpis.signal: Indicator of content richness and diversity of topics covered at the event.

kpis.name: Active Committees
kpis.explanation: Number of IVR committees and working groups actively functioning to achieve the organization's objectives.
kpis.description: IVR organizes its activities through various committees including the Loss Prevention Committee, the Legal Committee, and the Rheinschifffahrt Committee, which continue to work collaboratively.
kpis.signal: Indicator of the organization's operational capacity and scope of activities.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €8.03 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.93 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.97 Bn in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: IVR positions itself as an independent and neutral stakeholder in the European inland navigation sector, facilitating collaboration and knowledge sharing rather than developing proprietary AI solutions.
evidence: Organization of colloquia and congresses to facilitate knowledge exchange in the sector (2024 Annual Congress: 225 participants from 11 countries).
Active participation in international standardization bodies such as CESNI and the Central Commission for the Navigation of the Rhine (ZKR).
Focus on sustainability and technical adaptation of the sector through publication of technical sheets and recommendations for ship owners.
Coordination role among insurers, ship owners, and maritime authorities through a multi-layered organizational structure (General Assembly, Board of Directors, specialized committees).
